name: mealchain-invariants
_comment: Invarian yang HARUS selalu benar, bukan sekadar 'endpoint membalas 200'. Semua cek baca-saja: tidak menulis, tidak memanggil endpoint destruktif. Angka harapan sengaja 0 (pelanggaran), jadi setiap kegagalan berarti ada baris yang melanggar aturan domain. Cek 'keputusan tanpa jejak' dan 'executed tanpa persetujuan' adalah dua temuan yang sudah terukur pada 21 Okt 2026 (2 keputusan tanpa trace; 1 keputusan executed tanpa baris approvals yang approved).

http.name: chain untuk id yang tidak ada -> 404

db.run: docker exec mealchain-postgres psql -U mealchain -d mealchain -At -F "|" -c "{sql}"

checks.name: migrasi alembic head
checks.sql: SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version

checks.name: kolom agent_traces.parent_run_id ada (migrasi 039)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'agent_traces' AND column_name = 'parent_run_id'
checks._note: AUD-9A-03: baris VERIFY adalah run anak; tanpa kolom ini jejak auditor tidak bisa direkonstruksi dari DB.

checks.name: jumlah batch di DB
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM batches

checks.name: jumlah keputusan untuk Jakarta di DB (scope peran kepala SPPG)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d JOIN locations l ON l.id = d.target_location_id WHERE l.name = 'Jakarta'

checks.name: batch dengan kuantitas negatif
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM batches WHERE quantity_kg < 0

checks.name: batch diberangkatkan sebelum dipanen
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM batches WHERE dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND harvested_at IS NOT NULL AND dispatched_at < harvested_at

checks.name: baris kanonik batch ikut berstempel sesi (regresi 21 Okt)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM batches WHERE origin = 'seed' AND demo_session_id IS NOT NULL

checks.name: baris kanonik keputusan ikut berstempel sesi
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions WHERE origin = 'seed' AND demo_session_id IS NOT NULL

checks.name: baris kanonik pasokan ikut berstempel sesi
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM supply_records WHERE origin = 'seed' AND demo_session_id IS NOT NULL

checks.name: langkah LEARN pada status di luar rejected/proposed
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces t JOIN decisions d ON d.id = t.decision_id WHERE t.step_name = 'LEARN' AND d.status NOT IN ('rejected','proposed')
checks._note: LEARN ditulis saat keputusan diajukan ulang (rejection_loop.repropose): pada baris rejected dan pada draf barunya (proposed). Terukur 21 Okt: 2 LEARN di draf proposed.

checks.name: langkah ACT pada keputusan yang tidak executed
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces t JOIN decisions d ON d.id = t.decision_id WHERE t.step_name = 'ACT' AND d.status <> 'executed'

checks.name: jejak agent yatim (decision tidak ada)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces t LEFT JOIN decisions d ON d.id = t.decision_id WHERE d.id IS NULL

checks.name: keputusan tanpa satu pun jejak langkah (temuan 21 Okt: 2 baris)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_traces t WHERE t.decision_id = d.id)

checks.name: lebih dari satu PO untuk satu keputusan
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT decision_id FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY decision_id HAVING count(*) > 1) x

checks.name: jejak dengan step_at kosong
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces WHERE step_at IS NULL

checks.name: persetujuan yatim (keputusan tidak ada)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM approvals a LEFT JOIN decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id WHERE d.id IS NULL

checks.name: keputusan executed tanpa persetujuan (temuan 21 Okt: 1 baris)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d WHERE d.status = 'executed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals a WHERE a.decision_id = d.id AND a.approved)

checks.name: fakta pasokan melewati horizon 31 hari
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM supply_records WHERE recorded_at > now() + interval '31 days'

checks.name: fakta permintaan melewati horizon 31 hari
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM demand_records WHERE recorded_at > now() + interval '31 days'

checks.name: horizon pasokan tercatat (max recorded_at <= 31 hari)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM supply_records WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT max(recorded_at) FROM supply_records) AND recorded_at > now() + interval '31 days'

checks.name: PO tanpa berat (ordered_quantity <= 0) — audit data 26 Okt 2026
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE ordered_quantity <= 0

checks.name: PO bermaterial generik MAT-UMUM
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE upper(material_number) = 'MAT-UMUM'

checks.name: keputusan ditolak tanpa pencatat (baris approvals approved=false)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d WHERE d.status = 'rejected' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals a WHERE a.decision_id = d.id AND a.approved IS FALSE)

checks.name: jejak agent berisi teks template ('template status demo')
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces WHERE output_summary::text ILIKE '%template status demo%'

checks.name: sdc di jejak DECIDE sama dengan SDC keputusan (±1 rupiah)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_traces t JOIN decisions d ON d.id = t.decision_id WHERE (t.output_summary->>'sdc') IS NOT NULL AND d.safe_delivered_cost IS NOT NULL AND abs((t.output_summary->>'sdc')::numeric - d.safe_delivered_cost) > 1

checks.name: SDC != jumlah komponen cost_breakdown
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions d WHERE d.cost_breakdown ? 'purchase' AND d.safe_delivered_cost IS NOT NULL AND abs(d.safe_delivered_cost - ((d.cost_breakdown->>'purchase')::numeric + (d.cost_breakdown->>'transport')::numeric + (d.cost_breakdown->>'handling')::numeric + (d.cost_breakdown->>'expected_loss')::numeric + coalesce((d.cost_breakdown->>'freshness_risk')::numeric,0) + coalesce((d.cost_breakdown->>'safety_penalty')::numeric,0))) > 0.01
checks._note: Audit D-01/BL-01/NUM-01. Breakdown pada kartu 70% dulu disalin utuh sehingga selisih Rp 4,7-6,6 juta.

checks.name: blok ledger generasi aktif menunjuk entitas terhapus (yatim)
checks.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT generation FROM ledger_meta WHERE id = 1) SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_blocks lb, g WHERE lb.generation = g.generation AND lb.entity_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decisions d WHERE d.id = lb.entity_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batches b WHERE b.id = lb.entity_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = lb.entity_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locations l WHERE l.id = lb.entity_id)
checks._note: Audit D-02. Definisi sama dengan GET /ledger/verify (ledger_service.verify_chain).

checks.name: keputusan ber-origin demo (provenance tidak boleh vakum)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions WHERE origin = 'demo'
checks._note: Audit D-04. Dulu _bekukan menulis origin='seed' sehingga cek kanonik lulus tanpa satu pun baris demo.

checks.name: keputusan demo_case ber-origin seed (provenance hilang)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM decisions WHERE demo_case IS NOT NULL AND origin = 'seed'

checks.name: PO ber-decision_id (rantai keputusan->PO tidak vakum)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id IS NOT NULL
checks._note: Audit D-05/NUM-01: tanpa minimal satu PO tertaut, cek '>1 PO per keputusan' dan KPI Safe Delivered Cost lulus/mati secara vakum.

checks.name: PO menunjuk keputusan yang tidak ada
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders po WHERE po.decision_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decisions d WHERE d.id = po.decision_id)

checks.name: PO tanpa decision_id yang bukan baris impor SAP
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sap_mock_purchase_orders WHERE decision_id IS NULL AND (po_number !~ '^4500' OR origin <> 'seed')
checks._note: Baris impor SAP (4500000xxx, origin='seed') memang tidak lahir dari keputusan; PO lain WAJIB punya decision_id.
